Mockingbird is the key permanent: she enters play and stuns Rhino, cancelling his first attack. Playing her first before spending resources on other cards.

Pay Mockingbird's 3 cost with three energy cards (Aunt May, Spider-Tracer, Interrogation Room), keeping Surveillance Team (reliable threat control to play turn 2 with drawn cards) and Backflip (free defense event for Rhino's first real attack).
Flip to hero now so I can use basic attacks this turn, and so the villain attacks (stunned) instead of scheming against the low 7-threat scheme in the villain phase.
Rhino is stunned so there is no attack to save Mockingbird for; use her attack now — consequential damage is safe.
Use Spider-Man's basic power to attack every turn I can; threat is 0 so damage is the right basic power.
Only 2 cards in hand versus hand size 5 — keep both (Surveillance Team to play next turn, Backflip for Rhino's attack) and draw 3.

Black Cat is the strongest permanent available (repeatable 1 damage with no attack consequential, 2 HP body, on-play mental-card draw). Paying her 2 cost with Web-Shooter and For Justice! keeps Surveillance Team (threat control) and Backflip (for Rhino's first attack since the stun expired).
Spend Web-Shooter and For Justice! to keep Surveillance Team and Backflip in hand.
Guard minion must die: Spider-Man's 2 damage plus Mockingbird's 1 equals its 3 HP exactly, which frees Black Cat to hit Rhino.
Mockingbird's 1 damage finishes the 1-HP guard exactly, leaving Black Cat free to attack Rhino.

All allies and my basic power are exhausted. Surveillance Team's only payment would consume Backflip (needed for Rhino's imminent attack, since the stun expired) or Avengers Mansion (my 4-cost draw engine); threat is only 1-2 and safe, so both stay in hand. Staying hero so Rhino attacks rather than schemes.
Hand of 3 is below size 5 — keep all three (Backflip for this round's attack, Avengers Mansion and Surveillance Team to play next turn) and draw 2.

Mockingbird is at 1 HP — a textbook sacrificial defender: she absorbs the entire attack (excess lost, Rhino has no overkill), I take 0 damage, and Backflip stays in hand for a future attack while Spider-Man and Black Cat remain ready for full offense next turn.

Gang-Up's hero effect is a free villain attack (~3 damage). Cancelling it with Enhanced Spider-Sense spends only this situational event, while keeping Backflip for Rhino's guaranteed round-3 attack, 0 damage taken, full HP, and Spider-Man ready for a complete offensive turn.
Emergency is the most expendable: a 0-cost interrupt that only fires while the villain schemes (rare, since I stay hero), versus keeping Backflip, Webbed Up, Surveillance Team and Avengers Mansion.
Threat 2 of 7 is safe (hero form, +1 per round), so spend the basic power on damage.
Black Cat attacks with no consequential damage — free damage every turn she is ready.

Checklist step 3: Surveillance Team is a permanent I can pay for. Every payment pair sacrifices one of {Backflip, Avengers Mansion, Webbed Up}; Avengers Mansion (4-cost draw engine) is clearly the card to keep, so pay with Backflip and Webbed Up. Threat is low so losing event defenses for a permanent is correct, and I have 10 HP, DEF 3 and Mansion draws to absorb attacks.
Keep Avengers Mansion (draw engine); Backflip and Webbed Up are the expendable pair.

Threat at 2 of 7 with only +1 per round while hero form is safe — save Surveillance Team's 3 counters for side-scheme bursts and incite treacheries. Hand is just Avengers Mansion (unaffordable at 4 with no other cards), so draw up.
Keep Avengers Mansion and draw 4 up to hand size 5.

Attack is 2 plus boost (2-4 total) against 10 HP — hard rule: don't defend with the hero when the attack can't defeat or cripple me. Black Cat always dies defending (base ATK already equals her 2 HP) and she's my free-attack engine, so take the hit and keep everyone ready.

Advance would push the main scheme to 6/7 — one point from loss, forcing my whole next turn into thwarting and leaving every incite treachery lethal. Great Responsibility (free) converts the 3 threat into 3 damage: HP 8→5 is manageable with DEF 3, ally defenders, Mansion draws and Peter Parker's REC 3 heal later, while threat stays a comfortable 3/7 with all 3 Surveillance Team counters intact.

Swinging Web Kick's 8 damage exactly matches Rhino stage 1's remaining 8 HP — nothing wasted — and my basic attack plus Black Cat then hit the fresh stage 2. This is the checklist's biggest damage turn available.

Spider-Tracer is the weakest card (needs a minion to even play), while Interrogation Room triggers automatically on any minion defeat. Genius is a pure payment card doing its job; keeping Avengers Mansion is essential.

Breakin' & Takin' has exactly 3 threat and I have exactly 3 thwart sources (Spider-Man 1, Black Cat 1, Surveillance Team counter) — clearing it this turn removes the hazard (+1 encounter card every round) before it fires even once. This beats 3 damage on Rhino per the hazard-removal mandate, and I can clear it completely rather than leaving it with leftover threat.
Continue the complete clear of Breakin' & Takin' — Black Cat's 1 thwart brings it to 1.
Final Surveillance Team counter on Breakin' & Takin' completes the clear — hazard scheme discarded with zero threat left.
Clear Breakin' & Takin' completely so the hazard icon stops dealing extra encounter cards.

Interrogation Room's only payment would cost Avengers Mansion (4-cost engine for a 1-cost situational support) — not worth it. Flipping to alter-ego would let stage-2 Rhino scheme 1 + high boost + per-round push the 3/7 scheme to 7 — a possible loss. Hand is 2 cards, draw up to 5.
Below hand size — keep both and draw 3.

Attack is 3-5 versus 5 HP — undefended is 20-35% death, and defending with the hero would cost next turn's basic power. Black Cat is at 1 HP (any attack kills her anyway): sacrifice her body to absorb the whole hit, take 0 damage, keep Spider-Man ready to attack.

Charge makes Rhino's next attack 6+ with overkill versus my 5 HP — guaranteed death undefended, 30% death even defending with DEF 3. Webbed Up is the clean answer: it cancels the attack and stuns Rhino (neutralizing two activations), while keeping me in hero form with an offensive turn. Paying with the four situational cards keeps Avengers Mansion.
Spend the four situational cards; keep Avengers Mansion as the long-game draw engine.
Trim the main scheme 4→3 with a counter to maximize safety margin against the round's encounter card (threat would otherwise sit at 4 after per-round placement).
Threat is safe at 3; spend the basic power on damage since Webbed Up already handles the villain phase.
Hand is 1 card (Mansion unaffordable) — draw up to 5. Staying hero: Webbed Up needs to intercept the attack, and flipping to alter-ego would risk a scheme completing at boost 2 (3+1+1+2=7).
Keep Avengers Mansion, draw up to 5.

Rhino only heals 2 effective HP (13→15, capped at max). Enhanced Spider-Sense would cancel that but costs itself plus a payment card, and it's far more valuable saved for a future damaging or scheme treachery (Gang-Up, Advance-scale effects worth 3+).
